text.EN: We lost someone important. We need to stay together.
text.TL: Nawalan tayo ng mahalagang tao. Kailangan nating magsama-sama.

text.EN: They were our guiding light. I don't know what to do without them.
text.TL: Sila ang tanglaw natin. Hindi ko alam ang gagawin nang wala sila.

text.EN: I gave my loyalty to them. I feel empty inside.
text.TL: Ibinigay ko ang katapatan ko sa kanila. Parang walang laman ang puso ko.

text.EN: They inspired all of us. We must uphold their ideals.
text.TL: Binigyan nila tayo ng lakas. Dapat nating itaguyod ang simulain nila.

text.EN: Our beacon is extinguished. God help us.
text.TL: Namatay na ang tanglaw natin. Diyos ko tulungan mo kami.

text.EN: I would have followed them to the end. Rest well.
text.TL: Susundan ko sana sila hanggang dulo. Mamahinga ka na.

text.EN: They were everything to this cause. We cannot let it die.
text.TL: Sila ang lahat para sa layuning 'to. Hindi natin hahayaang mamatay 'to.

text.EN: My faith is shaken, but I will stay with our people.
text.TL: Nayanig ang pananampalataya ko, pero mananatili ako sa ating mga kasama.

text.EN: A visionary has fallen. We must honor their sacrifice.
text.TL: Bumagsak ang ating pinuno. Dapat nating igalang ang sakripisyo nila.

text.EN: They believed in us. We have to prove them right.
text.TL: Naniwala sila sa atin. Kailangan nating patunayan na tama sila.
